text: Kaiji resumes a paused LangGraph workflow with SQLite by reopening the database using a fresh Saver and the same thread_id. Native Runtime runs do not automatically resume from SQLite checkpoints.
Azusa provides BM25 keyword retrieval and stable chunk evidence over an HTTP gateway. The in-memory HNSW index is rebuilt separately.
The Formal runner restores a case and repeat matrix, verifies the request ledger and skips completed coordinates. It stops for audit if a started request has no finished response.
